messages:
Tom (ACME AP): Hi team — our invoice INV-2026-0423 failed to process, card declined and we need a PO attached. We need Net 60 on this customer, internal approvals take 45 days. Can we get terms?
Maria (Support): Sorry to hear that, Tom. I can help. Can you confirm invoice number and last 4 of the card? Also do you have a PO number we can attach? :wave:
Tom (ACME AP): Invoice INV-2026-0423, amount $48,000, card ends 1234. PO pending — procurement wants Net60 and invoice to reference PO# PO-8991. Approval will take till end of May.
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0423 generated by billing at 2024-06-19. PDF link: https://redwood.example/invoices/INV-2026-0423 (access restricted)
Jon (Billing): Hey — our standard is Net30. For Net terms we require a signed net terms agreement + credit review. For >$25k deals we usually require a 50% upfront for new customers.
Lisa (Account Exec): I can push for a 45-day exception; can we offer 30 days + extended credit or 50% upfront? Customer is strategic.
Tom (ACME AP): 50% upfront is possible, but procurement says no partial payment — need full invoice on Net60.
Maria (Support): Payment processor shows decline: error 402 card_declined, response: insufficient_funds. Also attempted three retries. Logs:
```processor.log
2024-06-19T15:10:22Z charge INV-2026-0423 error 402 card_declined insufficient_funds
2024-06-19T15:12:05Z retry1 error 402 card_declined
```
Jon (Billing): Given amount and no prior history, Finance won't approve Net60 without contract & PO upfront. Options: ACH/wire (can be paid on receipt), or place on Dedicated billing with credit checks. We can also run a quick trade reference check to approve Net45.
Tom (ACME AP): Wire is ok but procurement requires invoice matching PO. If we wire, can you update invoice to include PO#?
Jon (Billing): Yes, we can reissue invoice with PO# once legal signs terms. I can reissue and mark as 'Due on receipt' for wire. Need PO PDF.
Lisa (Account Exec): I'll get Legal on a 45-day limited net terms trial and chase procurement to sign PO. @Jon can you accept VAT reverse-charge if they are in EU? Tom is in Germany — VAT reverse-charge applies, they say.
Jon (Billing): Need their VAT ID. W-9 not required for EU customers. We can mark invoice with reverse charge if VAT ID provided. Also need billing contact for tax docs.
Tom (ACME AP): VAT ID DE123456789 provided attached. Also attaching PO draft PO-8991. Please confirm reissue and wire instructions.
Maria (Support): Marking ticket escalated to billing ops. I'll keep monitoring. :white_check_mark:
Jon (Billing): Received VAT ID and PO draft. I'll route to finance for Net45 sign-off; if we can't get approval, fallback is 50% upfront. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Tom (ACME AP): Thanks — appreciate the help.
Lisa (Account Exec): I'll post updates here. :pray:
